proposals.issue_title: GitHub Actions Shared IP Bans & Brittle API Connections
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runner IPs are highly recycled and blacklisted by public/free endpoints (AI Horde 403, Gemini 429). Unauthenticated API calls fail silently or break entire workflow runs, wasting Hugo's 10h/week on manual restarts.
proposals.proposed_fix: Standardize on authenticated API keys only (Together AI or Cloudflare Workers AI free tiers, or Runware PAYG). Implement a robust 'API Gateway' wrapper utility in Python with exponential backoff (tenacity library), fallback endpoints (if Together fails, try Cloudflare), and automated failure notifications via free Discord/Telegram webhooks.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 90% of silent script crashes on GitHub Actions; guarantees stable image generation without manual intervention.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Quality Assurance for Generated Images
proposals.current_pain_description: Raw image generators (Pollinations, FLUX-schnell) frequently output distorted anatomy, overlapping lines, or low-contrast coloring pages. Hugo must manually filter out bad images on his phone, which is extremely tedious.
proposals.proposed_fix: Use the free tier of Gemini 2.5 Flash's multimodal (vision) API to inspect generated images before saving them. Pass the image to Gemini with a strict evaluation prompt: 'Is this coloring book page clean, black and white only, with closed lines and no gray shading? Answer JSON: {pass: true/false, score: 0-100}'. Discard images scoring under 80.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Automates 100% of initial aesthetic filtering; Hugo only reviews high-potential designs, saving hours of manual screen time.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Repository Bloat and LFS Bandwidth Exhaustion
proposals.current_pain_description: Committing high-resolution PNGs directly to GitHub repositories will quickly exceed the 1GB soft limit and exhaust Git LFS free bandwidth (1GB/month limit). This risks account suspension or repository lockdowns.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate Cloudflare R2 object storage (free tier includes 10GB storage/month and 0€ egress fees). Modify generation pipelines to upload raw and processed image assets directly to R2 using `boto3` in Python, saving only lightweight metadata (URLs, tags, titles) in the GitHub repository state.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents repository suspension; bypasses Git LFS limits entirely; provides a direct URL for Etsy/KDP/Cults3D uploads.

proposals.issue_title: High Maintenance Overhead across 40+ Fragmented Scripts
proposals.current_pain_description: With over 40 distinct pipelines and agent scripts, there is massive code duplication (API calls, image resizing, SVG parsing, error handling). A change in Gemini API models requires manually editing dozens of files.
proposals.proposed_fix: Consolidate common utilities into a single local python module (e.g., `src/core/utils.py` or shared helper files). Centralize API client instantiations, image post-processing scripts (using Pillow), and GitHub State file updates into this core module. Have individual pipelines import from `core`.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces codebase size by 60%; ensures a single point of failure fix for API model deprecations; simplifies Termux sync.

proposals.issue_title: Missed Cross-Pollination of Assets (1 Design -> N Products)
proposals.current_pain_description: An asset generated for a 'coloring book' stays in the coloring book folder. It is not automatically repurposed as an SVG pack, a KDP cover background, a POD sticker design, or a social media promo video layout.
proposals.proposed_fix: Build a simple 'Asset Router' pipeline. Once an asset passes the Gemini Vision QA check, its metadata is logged. The Asset Router automatically triggers secondary formatting scripts: (1) resizing to 300 DPI for print, (2) converting black & white lines to vector SVGs (using Potrace), (3) generating social media mockups (using Jinja templates over background assets).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory volume by 3x to 5x for the exact same image generation cost and time investment.

proposals.issue_title: Silent GitHub Actions Failures and State Corruption
proposals.current_pain_description: If a GitHub Actions run times out or encounters an unhandled exception mid-write, the main system state file (`state.json`) can be left corrupted, partially written, or out of sync. Hugo has no immediate visibility of this on his Android phone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement atomic file writing for `state.json` (write to `state.json.tmp` first, then rename). Use a GitHub Actions `always()` step to ping a free status-monitoring endpoint (like Healthchecks.io) or send a formatted failure report payload directly to Hugo's Telegram/Discord via a simple webhook curl command.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees zero state corruption; provides real-time push notifications of system failures directly to Hugo's mobile phone.
